# Jest Unit Test Writer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Jest

## Overview

Writes comprehensive unit tests with Jest including describe/it blocks, assertions, setup/teardown, and test organization

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jest-unit-test-writer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jest-unit-test-writer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jest-unit-test-writer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write structured tests with describe and it blocks
- Use expect assertions with proper matchers
- Implement beforeEach/afterEach for setup/teardown
- Create parameterized tests with test.each

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Jest API**: Test runner API and assertion matchers
- **AAA Pattern**: Arrange, Act, Assert test structure
- **Test Organization**: File and describe block organization
